extraction_passes.method: Every PDF page was rendered to PNG with Ghostscript and inspected with the image viewing tool.

PyMuPDF: text layer pulled per page; the 479-row Position Tracking table parsed by binning words on their x-coordinate into the published column boundaries; embedded raster images pulled at native resolution from the PDF object stream and matched to their keyword label by page geometry; every Map Rank Tracker grid point classified by modal RGB and its rank integer transcribed visually.
extraction_passes.why_not_playwright: These are local PDFs, not web pages. Rendering them through a browser would have produced downsampled screenshots of the heatmaps; reading the embedded PNG objects directly gives the original 820x800 rasters Semrush shipped, which is what the digits and colour bands had to be read from.
validation: Position Tracking: 479 parsed rows with contiguous indices 1..479; per-domain top-3/10/20/100 counts recomputed from the parsed rows reproduce the PDF's own Rankings Distribution tables exactly for all five tracked domains.

Map Rank Tracker: all 1127 grid points classified deterministically (colour distance 0.0, sample purity 1.00); all 1127 visually transcribed integers fall inside the band their pixel colour independently proves — 0 mismatches.

sources.embedded_images: 50 AI-platform badge graphics, no data content
23 keyword heatmaps at 820x800; all data lives in these rasters, the text layer carries only the keyword labels
